description_en: Queries the information about a parameter template
description_zh: 该接口用于查询指定的RDS参数模板信息
kebab_example: aliyun rds describe-parameter-group --parameter-group-id rpg-dp0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeParameterGroup

parameters.help_en: The parameter template ID. You can call the DescribeParameterGroups operation to query the parameter template ID
parameters.help_zh: 参数模板ID。可以通过接口DescribeParameterGroups查看参数模板ID
parameters.name: parameter_group_id

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call the DescribeRegions operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可以通过接口DescribeRegions查看地域ID
parameters.name: region_id
